jewellery_specs_weights_ck.name: jewellery_specs_weights_ck
jewellery_specs_weights_ck.value: coalesce("jewellery_specs"."gross_g",0) >= 0 and coalesce("jewellery_specs"."net_g",0) >= 0 and coalesce("jewellery_specs"."stone_g",0) >= 0 and coalesce("jewellery_specs"."fine_g",0) >= 0

price_books_window_ck.name: price_books_window_ck
price_books_window_ck.value: "price_books"."effective_from" is null or "price_books"."effective_to" is null or "price_books"."effective_to" > "price_books"."effective_from"

credit_entries_sign_ck.name: credit_entries_sign_ck
credit_entries_sign_ck.value: ("credit_entries"."type" in ('order_charge') and "credit_entries"."amount_minor" > 0) or ("credit_entries"."type" in ('order_release','payment','advance') and "credit_entries"."amount_minor" < 0) or ("credit_entries"."type" = 'adjustment' and "credit_entries"."amount_minor" <> 0)

shipments_shipped_ck.name: shipments_shipped_ck
shipments_shipped_ck.value: "shipments"."status" not in ('shipped','delivered') or "shipments"."shipped_at" is not null
